segments.content: Determina l'insieme delle soluzioni della seguente disequazione di secondo grado a coefficienti frazionari.

blocks.alt_text: (x minus 1) squared over 4 minus (x plus 1) over 2 is greater than or equal to 0

segments.content: Iniziamo sviluppando il quadrato e eliminando i denominatori. Il minimo comune multiplo di 4 e 2 è 4. Moltiplichiamo tutta la disequazione per 4 (il verso non cambia):

blocks.alt_text: 4 times (x minus 1) squared over 4 minus 4 times (x plus 1) over 2 is greater than or equal to 4 times 0

segments.content: Semplifichiamo e risolviamo:

blocks.alt_text: (x minus 1) squared minus 2 times (x plus 1) is greater than or equal to 0. Then x squared minus 2x plus 1 minus 2x minus 2 is greater than or equal to 0. Then x squared minus 4x minus 1 is greater than or equal to 0.

segments.content: Ora consideriamo l'equazione associata

blocks.alt_text: x squared minus 4x minus 1 equals 0

x equals (4 plus or minus the square root of (minus 4 squared minus 4 times 1 times minus 1)) all over (2 times 1). Then x equals (4 plus or minus the square root of (16 plus 4)) all over 2. Then x equals (4 plus or minus the square root of 20) all over 2. Then x equals (4 plus or minus 2 times square root of 5) all over 2.
x_1 equals 2 minus square root of 5, approximately minus 0.236. And x_2 equals 2 plus square root of 5, approximately 4.236.
